newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisie Leasing in new bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Tunisie Leasing in new bond issue.

text.p: Tunisie Leasing, a privately owned lease firm, said it was on the debt market with a new bond issue worth 10 million dinars ($9.4 million).

It said it started offering on Monday 100,000 five-year bonds at a nominal price of 100 dinars each, with a 9.25 percent coupon rate for paper payable in equal annual tranches and 9.75 percent for paper payable at maturity.
Five-year bond of a nominal 100 dinars would be disbursed 159.229 dinars at maturity on June 18, 2002 it said.
Subscription will be closed by June 18, 1997.
Previous bond issues by the firm were in October and December last year for a total 10 million dinars.
The firm's net profits amounted to 2.662 million dinars in 1996, up from 2.236 million dinars in 1995. ($=1.07 dinar)
